study.title: Different Brain Activation after Acupuncture at Combined Acupoints and Single Acupoint in Hypertension Patients: An Rs-fMRI Study Based on ReHo Analysis
study.study_design: Randomized controlled three-arm parallel-group resting-state fMRI study
study.randomization: Randomly divided into three groups following random number table
study.inclusion_criteria: (1) Patients with grade 1 or 2 hypertension, taking antihypertensive medicine regularly and maintaining a stable BP during the experiment. (2) Aged 40-65 years, right-handed. Male or female is not limited. (3) Compliant with the diagnostic criteria and risk stratification standard in hypertension guidelines revised and published by World Health Organization (WHO)/ International Society of Hypertension (ISH). (4) Having not received acupuncture within 1 month before the test. (5) All the subjects signed the appropriate informed consent paperwork and were willing to cooperate in the experiment.
study.exclusion_criteria: (1) Having been diagnosed with cerebrovascular accident and/or combined with other serious diseases, or acupuncture contraindications such as coagulation disorders, haemophilia, etc. (2) Females in pregnancy or lactation and patients with mental diseases. (3) Acupoint site with skin damage or disease. (4) Having suffered from different pain including dysmenorrhea within 1 month, which may affect therapeutic effect. (5) Having fainted before during acupuncture. (6) Having received acupuncture within 1 month before the test. (7) Having intense reaction to noise or in low-temperature environment and claustrophobic.

neuroimaging_methods.scanner_manufacturer_model_exact: GE 3.0T MRI scanner (Signa Excite System, General Electric Medical Systems, Milwaukee, WI, USA)
neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: (1) Transverse T1-Weighted Image (T1WI): fast spin echo sequence; OAx T1 FLAIR, repetition time = 1,750 ms, echo time = 24 ms, inversion time = 960 ms, field of view = 24 × 24 cm2, matrix = 320 × 224, number of excitations = 1, thickness = 5.0 mm; interval = 1.0 mm; slice layers = 30; echo train length = 8; bandwidth = 31.25. (2) Resting-State fMRI BOLD: Gradient echo-echo-planar imaging sequence; repetition time = 3,000 ms/minimum, echo time = minimum; flip angle = 90°; field of view = 240 mm × 240 mm; thickness = 5.0 mm; interval = 1.0 mm; slice layer = 30 slices per acquisition; matrix = 96 × 96; number of excitations = 1.
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: thickness = 5.0 mm; interval = 1.0 mm; matrix = 96 × 96; field of view = 240 mm × 240 mm
neuroimaging_methods.preprocessing_software_exact: Data Processing Assistant for resting-state fMRI (DPARSF) (Yan and Zang, 2010) based on Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM8) and the resting-state fMRI Data Analysis Toolkit (REST, Song et al., 2011) on Matlab R2009a platform
neuroimaging_methods.normalization_template_exact: MNI template developed by the Montreal Neurological Institute, Canada; fitting between the MNI template and the 3 mm x 3 mm x 3 mm sample
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: spatial smoothing (parameters not specified beyond the pipeline description)
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: Data of subjects that three-dimensionally panned > 1.5 mm and (or) rotated > 1.5° were removed
neuroimaging_methods.global_signal_regression_exact: nuisance covariates regression performed; covariates included head motion with ripid-body 6 head model, white matter signal, and cerebrospinal fluid signal
statistical_thresholds_exact: paired t-test α = 0.05, AlphaSim correction P < 0.05, continuous voxel > 85

extraction_notes.note: No quantitative deqi/sensation measurement instrument was used or reported. Deqi is described qualitatively in the intervention description only ('feelings like soreness, numbness, heaviness, fullness, etc.'). No MASS, VAS, or other deqi scale scores were reported.
Expectancy, credibility, and blinding success were not assessed or reported in this study. No instrument names, scores, or references to these constructs were found in the paper.
Adverse events were not reported. The paper does not mention whether any adverse events occurred during or after acupuncture treatment.

No quantitative clinical blood pressure outcomes are reported in this paper. The paper references reduced BP as a result from a prior study (Wang et al. [5]) by the same group, not a directly measured outcome in this study.

For LR3 group: no significant difference of brain regions between pre- and postacupuncture was found. The paper states this explicitly ('the results showed no significant difference of brain regions in LR3 group between pre- and postacupuncture'). No coordinate table was provided for this group.

Table 2 cluster 3 is labeled as 'Parietal lobe, postcentral gyrus' on the Left side with Brodmann area 3, while cluster 4 is labeled 'Right parietal lobe, postcentral gyrus' with Brodmann area 40. Brodmann area 3 is somatosensory cortex. The text in results section refers to 'BAs 3, 18 and 40' activated in LR3+KI3 group; this is consistent with clusters 1, 3, and 4 from Table 2.

The statistical model used for between-group comparison is described as 'one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) or Kruskal-Wallis H' in the methods section. It is unclear which test was applied to the neuroimaging data specifically. The choice between ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis H is not specified for the neuroimaging analysis.
The paper states that the post-acupuncture scan was performed '15 minutes after the needles withdrawn.' It is unclear whether the 15-minute rest period was inside or outside the scanner.
Smoothing kernel size is not explicitly reported. The paper mentions 'spatial smoothing' as one of the 6 preprocessing steps but does not specify FWHM or kernel size.
Band-pass filtering parameters are not reported. It is not stated whether temporal filtering was applied to the fMRI data prior to ReHo computation.

The paper states voxel size for normalization as '3 mm x 3 mm x 3 mm sample' in the context of fitting the MNI template, but acquisition slice thickness is 5.0 mm with 1.0 mm interval. The resampling procedure is described but exact final analysis voxel dimensions are given only as 3 mm isotropic.
Sample size justification or power calculation is not reported. With n=10 per group, the study may be underpowered, as acknowledged in the limitations.
No healthy control group was included. The authors acknowledge this in the limitations section: 'without healthy control group, the changes of brain activities were compared with the baseline.'
The paper does not report individual participant demographic details (age, disease duration, medication types/doses) by group, making it difficult to assess group balance beyond sex composition.
No PMID is available from the document. The DOI 10.1155/2019/5262896 and article ID 5262896 are the primary identifiers.

The figure color bar label '-2.14' appears in Figures 4 and 5, and '-2.05' in Figures 6 and 7, but the statistical threshold for the maps is described as AlphaSim-corrected P < 0.05, continuous voxel > 85. The relationship between these color bar values and the statistical thresholds is not explicitly clarified in the text.
Correlation analysis between altered blood pressure and changed ReHo value regions was not performed; the authors list this as a limitation.
